主要内容: President Donald Trump signed a bill to prevent a government shutdown after funding for the federal government briefly lapsed. The bill ensures the government remains operational until December 11, avoiding a potential shutdown during the pandemic and before the 2020 election. The Senate passed the temporary spending bill on Wednesday, and the House approved it last week. The Office of Management and Budget did not order agencies to cease operations. The law includes $8 billion for nutrition assistance and refreshes the Pandemic EBT food aid program. Both Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin and House Speaker Nancy Pelosi expressed hope for a deal on a fifth coronavirus aid package. The Supreme Court vacancy and confirmation of Judge Amy Coney Barrett will also occupy Senate time before the election.
